versions.subject: feat: new rule `proc_creation_macos_add_to_admin_group`.yml (#4121)
versions.detection:
selection_sysadminctl: #creates and adds new user to admin group
    Image|endswith: '/sysadminctl'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -addUser '
        - ' -admin '
selection_dscl: #adds to admin group
    Image|endswith: '/dscl'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -append '
        - ' /Groups/admin '
        - ' GroupMembership '
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (Image="*/sysadminctl" CommandLine="* -addUser *" CommandLine="* -admin *") OR (Image="*/dscl" CommandLine="* -append *" CommandLine="* /Groups/admin *" CommandLine="* GroupMembership *")
